==English==

===Etymology===
From {{uder|en|fro|reflect|reflecter|to bend back, turn back}}, from {{uder|en|la|reflectō||to reflect}}, from {{m|la|re-||again}} + {{m|la|flectō||to bend, to curve}}. Compare {{cog|en|reflex}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ɹɪˈflɛkt/}}
* {{audio|en|en-us-reflect.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɛkt|s=2}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[bend]] [[back]] ([[light]], etc.) from a [[surface]].
#: {{ux|en|A mirror '''reflects''' the light that shines on it.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To be bent back (light, etc.) from a surface.
#: {{ux|en|The moonlight '''reflected''' from the surface of water.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[mirror]], or show the [[image]] of something.
#: {{ux|en|The shop window '''reflected''' his image as he walked past.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To be [[mirror|mirrored]].
#: {{ux|en|His image '''reflected''' from the shop window as he walked past.}}
# {{senseid|en|closely follow}} {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[agree]] with; to closely [[follow]].
#: {{ux|en|Entries in English dictionaries aim to '''reflect''' common usage.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To give [[evidence]] of someone's or something's [[character]] etc.
#: {{ux|en|The team's victory '''reflects''' the Captain's abilities.}}
#: {{ux|en|The teacher's ability '''reflects''' well on the school.}}
#* {{RQ:Schuster Hepaticae|volume=V|page=vii|text=With fresh material, taxonomic conclusions are leavened by recognition that the material examined '''reflects''' the site it occupied; a herbarium packet gives one only a small fraction of the data desirable for sound conclusions. Herbarium material does not, indeed, allow one to extrapolate safely: what you see is what you get{{...}}}}
# {{senseid|en|think seriously}} {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[think]] [[seriously]]; to [[ponder]] or [[consider]].
#: {{ux|en|People do that sort of thing every day, without ever stopping to '''reflect''' on the consequences.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1985|author=w:Justin Richards|title=Option Lock|page=229
|passage=Not for the first time, he '''reflected''' that it was not so much the speeches that strained the nerves as the palaver that went with them.}}

====Synonyms====
* See also [[Thesaurus:ponder]]
